title: Implement Request Logging Middleware
description: This feature provides detailed logging of incoming requests, which is crucial for debugging and security auditing. It will record request headers, query parameters, and response status codes. This middleware will help developers identify and fix issues more efficiently
acceptance: The request logging middleware must log all incoming requests with their corresponding headers, query parameters, and response status codes without affecting the request-response flow
reason: Improved debugging and security auditing capabilities are essential for a production-ready framework like Yantraverse
